summary: The premise is false: the parent's submission.py (blob 1774e42c, branch tip = impl fc959d9c) already contains master's align-parallel-per-expert-verify and w2-marlin-atomic-add-small-m code verbatim, so the restack's correct output is byte-identical to the code that already scored 1.3727x in 4e4a0e26c85944f2. Running it would spend a scored submit to re-measure identical code. Promote the parent's blob to master directly instead, with no run.
justification: A. Content, not git ancestry, decides this. Git ancestry does say the parent sits on 928151c (s4), which is not a master descendant. But the s4/s5 lineage was rebased by content onto master 9080a71 (FINDINGS says 'same s4 base rebased onto master 9080a71'), and 928151c's file already has _align_parallel_kernel and _w2_atomic_self_check. Line-diffing master's submission.py (blob 60dfe35d) against the parent's (1774e42c), only 5 master lines are missing from the parent, and all 5 come from moving master's _forward body into _moe_marlin(x, topk_ids, topk_weights, bank, state, w2_mode) (data['topk_ids'] -> topk_ids, return out -> return out, local_ids, cache2, y; kernel_fn now branches to _moe_wgmma or _moe_marlin). _moe_marlin is master's _forward launch for launch: _align_small for T<=32, _align_parallel above, two-smaller block_size_m at T>=128, the w2 atomic-add/atomic_zero path at T<=W2_ATOMIC_MAX_TOKENS=32 driven by state['w2_mode'] from the same _w2_atomic_self_check, and the same post-norm split. The change paragraph's sub-requirement is also already met. _wg_select times _moe_marlin(..., 'master'), which runs master's new align at T>=128. w2_mode='master' there is exact, because the atomic-add flag only applies at T<=32 and the selector buckets are T>=128. So 'master's current Marlin path' is what the selector already compares against. A 3-way git merge-file with base 928151c conflicts only on hunks where master lacks the wgmma additions, and resolving every one toward the parent gives the parent's file. The expected rows are also wrong: verify_32 'faster' was the parent's gain over the old master. Against the board (the parent's own score) the honest expectation is flat on every shape, with only run-to-run noise around 1.3727 [1.352,1.393]. Weakest link: the stated mechanism ('this should score at or above it, since master's own promotions were +0.03 over the parent's base') assumes the parent lacked those promotions. It did not; the +0.03 is already inside 1.3727.
confounders: align-parallel-per-expert-verify: already present verbatim in the parent (_align_parallel_kernel, _align_parallel, the extended _align_self_check, the warm-up), and used by both _moe_marlin and the _wg_select Marlin timing. Nothing to add, so nothing to confound.

w2-marlin-atomic-add-small-m: already present verbatim (W2_ATOMIC_MAX_TOKENS, _w2_atomic_self_check, the w2_mode plumbing in _moe_marlin). It applies only at T<=32, which the wgmma path (T>=128) never touches. No interaction.
interference: No companion. The run itself is uninformative: identical code (same blob as scored job 4e4a0e26c85944f2) can only reproduce 1.3727 within noise. A companion would cost another scored run to learn nothing more. The project convention says identical code is never re-run, and that applies directly here.
rules_flags: None new: the restacked code is the parent's code, which already passed check and scored submit.

Bookkeeping, not a competition rule: BEST.json records submission_blob 60dfe35d, which is master's current blob and not the scored parent's (1774e42c). Fix this when promoting, or a later 'is master == board?' check will be misled.
open_questions: Can churn promote the parent's blob directly (copy hyp/muse_moe_w4a16/cuda-nvfp4-wgmma-rega-grouped-s5-copy-safe-bucket-gate:muse_moe_w4a16/submission.py, blob 1774e42c, onto master as a promote commit citing scored job 4e4a0e26c85944f2) without a run? That achieves this hypothesis's whole goal (master == board code) for zero checks and zero submits.
If policy requires a run before every promotion, is a re-measure of an already-scored blob allowed, or should the promotion be recorded against 4e4a0e26c85944f2?

Why was the parent's outcome filed as neutral/unproven-vs-best and not promoted, given it scored 1.3727 above the 1.3439 board? The promotion gate may be comparing against something other than the board.
